title: Rabbi Avshalom the Elder (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Mekhilta, Vayehi Beshalach 4:10 (Hyman cites chapter 3)](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Vayehi_Beshalach.4.10). Perhaps he is the father of Rabbi Natan mentioned in a baraita in [Berakhot 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22a.6). The Vilna Gaon's reading, however, is Rabbi Avtilos, as also in [Shemot Rabbah 21:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Shemot_Rabbah.21.8).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Mekhilta gives Avtolis the Elder in Hebrew and Avshalom the Elder in Silverstein’s English. The parallel in Shemot Rabbah also names Avtolis the Elder. Berakhot gives Natan ben Avishalom. The proposed father identification and the exact Vilna Gaon reading remain Hyman’s reports.
